column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah E99009: Ateraxis menyerbu markas Red Zone, melepas Chiloveig,
# dan berpisah dari Caldwell.
# Tetap Inggris: Ateraxis, Caldwell, Chiloveig, Paradeus, Niter, Nyto, Doll, Frame,
# Neural cloud, Boojum, Relics, Relic Technology, Nirvana, Red Zone, ELID, The Elmo,
# Commander, Elif Nemesis, Helena, Lunasia, Jojo, Lviv, Child of the Relics, Mother,
# Big Sis, force field, mech, ray cannon, javelin.
# Puisi yang dibacakan Ateraxis = "Darkness" (Byron) — diterjemahkan puitis, bukan harfiah.
(The Red Zone, far from the borders of human civilization, is a hell ravaged by ELID and severe radiation. Even for non-human existences, this is not an area where one can easily survive.)
column2: (Red Zone, jauh dari batas peradaban manusia, adalah neraka yang dirusak ELID dan radiasi parah. Bahkan bagi eksistensi non-manusia, ini bukan wilayah yang bisa ditinggali dengan mudah.)

column1: (No matter how it's dressed up in grand rhetoric, the fact remains that Paradeus, once mighty, is now in a period of decline and dormancy.)
column2: (Sekalipun dibungkus retorika megah, faktanya tetap sama: Paradeus yang dulu perkasa kini berada dalam masa kemunduran dan mati suri.)

column1: (But as for this stronghold hidden deep in the core of the Red Zone, the silhouette of its former majestic strength can still be vaguely seen—the reinforced gray building complexes and tightly laid out artillery batteries, defense arrays, and missile launchers far exceed the upper limit allowed for a military base.)
column2: (Tapi di benteng yang tersembunyi jauh di inti Red Zone ini, siluet kekuatan agungnya yang dulu masih terlihat samar—kompleks bangunan kelabu yang diperkuat, baterai artileri yang tersusun rapat, array pertahanan, dan peluncur misil jauh melampaui batas yang diizinkan untuk sebuah pangkalan militer.)

column1: (And the heavy tanks and mechs stationed here have also been modified, fully utilizing the lethal radiation energy of the surrounding environment, possessing stronger performance and firepower than military armaments.)
column2: (Tank berat dan mech yang ditempatkan di sini pun sudah dimodifikasi, memanfaatkan penuh energi radiasi mematikan dari lingkungan sekitar, sehingga performa dan daya tembaknya melebihi persenjataan militer biasa.)

column1: (As the personnel stationed here, naturally they wouldn't be ordinary humans or Dolls. Nearly a hundred Niters and several Nytos took on various tasks including defense, and for them, this was not a very difficult task.)
column2: (Sebagai personel yang bertugas di sini, jelas mereka bukan manusia atau Doll biasa. Hampir seratus Niter dan beberapa Nyto memegang berbagai tugas termasuk pertahanan, dan bagi mereka ini bukan tugas yang sulit.)

column1: (Until tonight.)
column2: (Sampai malam ini.)

column1: There are actually stars tonight—?
column2: Malam ini ada bintang—?

column1: (Several Niters responsible for night guard duty felt something was off during their first round of patrols. The dense radiation clouds that constantly shroud the skies above the Red Zone had somehow dissipated in one corner, and the faint silver-gray light reflected on their enhanced retinas.)
column2: (Beberapa Niter yang bertugas jaga malam merasa ada yang tidak beres di ronde patroli pertama. Awan radiasi tebal yang selalu menyelimuti langit Red Zone entah bagaimana menghilang di satu sudut, dan cahaya kelabu-keperakan yang samar terpantul di retina mereka yang telah ditingkatkan.)

column1: (Beneath a cascade of faint light falling from the sky, a slender, graceful figure strolls over.)
column2: (Di bawah curahan cahaya samar yang turun dari langit, sebuah figur ramping dan elegan berjalan santai mendekat.)

column1: Good evening.
column2: Selamat malam.

column1: Was she sent by Lady Caldwell? Contact her quickly—we haven't received any instructions from our superiors.
column2: Apa dia dikirim Lady Caldwell? Cepat hubungi beliau—kami belum menerima instruksi apa pun dari atasan.

column1: This is not my instruction.
column2: Ini bukan instruksiku.

column1: (Under the holographic projection of the emergency contact, the Chief Scholar didn't seem surprised by the interruption, but leisurely continued her ongoing work, walking around, recording, and setting up various devices from time to time.)
column2: (Di balik proyeksi holografis kontak darurat itu, Chief Scholar tampak tidak terganggu oleh interupsi, malah santai melanjutkan pekerjaannya—berkeliling, mencatat, dan sesekali memasang berbagai perangkat.)

column1: (Facing the nervous inquiries of the Niters, she just answered casually.)
column2: (Menghadapi pertanyaan gelisah para Niter, dia hanya menjawab sekenanya.)

column1: Since there are no instructions from you, even Lady Ateraxis cannot intrude... I hope you can ask her to leave.
column2: Kalau tidak ada instruksi dari Anda, Lady Ateraxis pun tidak boleh masuk... Saya mohon Anda menyuruhnya pergi.

column1: Unfortunately... I can't do that. Even with my power and knowledge expanding exponentially, I still can't overcome psychological issues—it's a valuable lesson for me too.
column2: Sayangnya... aku tidak bisa. Meski kekuatan dan pengetahuanku berkembang secara eksponensial, aku masih belum mampu mengatasi masalah psikologis—ini pelajaran berharga untukku juga.

column1: ...What does that mean, please?
column2: ...Apa maksudnya, kalau saya boleh tahu?

column1: It's just that Ateraxis has currently broken free from my control and is acting on her own will, so I cannot fulfill your request.
column2: Ateraxis saat ini sudah lepas dari kendaliku dan bergerak atas kehendaknya sendiri, jadi aku tidak bisa memenuhi permintaanmu.

column1: W-what did you say?
column2: A-apa katamu?

column1: But Ateraxis... she's the greatest combat asset we currently have, right?! If she betrays us, wouldn't the situation be completely out of control?!
column2: Tapi Ateraxis... dia aset tempur terbesar yang kita punya sekarang, kan?! Kalau dia berbalik melawan kami, situasinya jadi benar-benar tak terkendali!

column1: Although she is indeed disobedient, it's not a betrayal. That child probably doesn't want to make enemies of you either.
column2: Dia memang tidak patuh, tapi ini bukan pembelotan. Anak itu kemungkinan juga tidak ingin bermusuhan dengan kalian.

column1: If you want advice, I do have one piece.
column2: Kalau kalian mau saran, aku punya satu.

column1: Advice?
column2: Saran?

column1: Do not take any hostile actions. I know you've deployed a lot of forces there, but in front of her, they are all useless.
column2: Jangan lakukan tindakan agresif apa pun. Aku tahu kalian menempatkan banyak kekuatan di sana, tapi di hadapannya semua itu tidak berguna.

column1: This child will leave once she gets what she wants. Just treat it as the privilege of the strong and let her take whatever she wants—I will explain it to your superiors.
column2: Anak itu akan pergi begitu mendapat yang dia inginkan. Anggap saja itu hak istimewa yang kuat, biarkan dia mengambil apa pun—aku yang akan menjelaskannya ke atasan kalian.

column1: What... we cannot obey such an unreasonable request, please—
column2: Apa... kami tidak bisa menuruti permintaan yang tidak masuk akal seperti itu, mohon—

column1: (The communication was unilaterally cut off, and the Nytos looked at each other in dismay.)
column2: (Komunikasi diputus sepihak, dan para Nyto saling berpandangan dengan bingung.)

column1: (Although Caldwell gave permission to yield, they did not intend to choose that path—after all, possessing firepower capable of resisting an army at this moment, announcing surrender to just one individual completely exceeded their common sense.)
column2: (Meski Caldwell memberi izin untuk mengalah, mereka tidak berniat memilih jalan itu—lagi pula, dengan daya tembak yang mampu menahan satu pasukan, menyatakan menyerah kepada satu individu saja benar-benar di luar akal sehat mereka.)

column1: (Even if that individual was Caldwell's "masterpiece", the creature that terrified them was no exception.)
column2: (Bahkan jika individu itu adalah "masterpiece" Caldwell, makhluk yang meneror mereka itu tetap bukan pengecualian.)

column1: (And just as the Niters were talking, Ateraxis had already arrived at the gate of the base. Her expression was incredibly relaxed, as if strolling in a garden, admiring everything around her, softly reciting an ancient poem.)
column2: (Dan tepat saat para Niter masih berbicara, Ateraxis sudah tiba di gerbang pangkalan. Ekspresinya luar biasa santai, seolah berjalan-jalan di taman, mengagumi segala hal di sekitarnya, sembari melantunkan sebuah puisi kuno dengan lirih.)

column1: I had a dream, which was not all a dream.
column2: Aku bermimpi, yang bukan sekadar mimpi.

column1: The bright sun was extinguish'd, and the stars
column2: Matahari yang terang telah padam, dan bintang-bintang

column1: Did wander darkling in the eternal space…
column2: Mengembara kelam di ruang yang kekal…

column1: (Her ethereal voice and tranquil expression were like a fairy from mythology, but the building in front of her responded with flashing red lights and piercing alarms. She raised her hand, and the force field suddenly exerted power, crushing the alloy gate and a concrete wall in front of her at the same time.)
column2: (Suaranya yang halus dan ekspresinya yang tenang bagai peri dari mitologi, tapi bangunan di depannya menjawab dengan lampu merah berkedip dan alarm yang memekakkan. Dia mengangkat tangan, dan force field seketika bekerja, menghancurkan gerbang alloy sekaligus satu dinding beton di depannya.)

column1: (What greeted her was a dense hail of bullets and scorching rays, as if fighting an entire high-threat armored force: mechs, chariots, fully armed soldiers—as well as Niters and Nytos, unreservedly unleashing their maximum firepower on a mere single figure.)
column2: (Yang menyambutnya adalah hujan proyektil padat dan sinar membara, seolah sedang menghadapi seluruh pasukan armor berancaman tinggi: mech, kereta perang, tentara bersenjata lengkap—juga Niter dan Nyto, melepaskan daya tembak maksimal tanpa ragu ke satu figur seorang diri.)

column1: Rayless, and pathless, and the icy earth
column2: Tanpa cahaya, tanpa jalan, dan bumi yang membeku

column1: Swung blind and blackening in the moonless air—
column2: Berputar buta dan menghitam di udara tanpa bulan—

column1: (She left behind her the sighs, and the bullet rain and blasts that couldn't catch up to her, as she spun and slipped past like a dance. Her figure passed through the clamorous artillery fire, like a sharp glass dagger, cutting into the defender's soft underbelly.)
column2: (Dia meninggalkan di belakangnya keluh napas, hujan proyektil, dan ledakan yang tak mampu menyusulnya, sembari berputar dan menyelip seperti menari. Figurnya melintasi gemuruh tembakan artileri, bagai belati kaca yang tajam, menghunjam perut lunak pihak bertahan.)

column1: (The huge mechs that hadn't had time to be revealed on the battlefield had their legs torn off, and the cockpit covers cracked open like walnuts. Ray cannons were penetrated and exploded one after another. Ateraxis released crystal-like javelins from her hands, piercing the missile devices hidden behind cover.)
column2: (Mech-mech raksasa yang belum sempat menampakkan diri di medan tempur kakinya tercabut, dan penutup kokpitnya terbelah seperti kenari. Ray cannon ditembus lalu meledak satu demi satu. Ateraxis melepaskan javelin sebening kristal dari tangannya, menembus perangkat misil yang bersembunyi di balik penutup.)

column1: (To the Niters and Nytos, commonly called 'monsters' or 'apostles' by ordinary people, what they saw was, in their own eyes, something close to both a nightmare and a myth.)
column2: (Bagi para Niter dan Nyto, yang biasa disebut 'monster' atau 'apostle' oleh orang biasa, apa yang mereka saksikan—di mata mereka sendiri—adalah sesuatu yang mendekati mimpi buruk sekaligus mitos.)

column1: What is this—
column2: Apa-apaan ini—

column1: (The Niter who had previously communicated with Caldwell didn't notice her approach, only confused that the shooting target suddenly disappeared before her eyes. The next moment she found herself thrown high into the air. Between the inversion of heaven and earth, she watched in despair as that figure destroyed the position in front of her.)
column2: (Niter yang sebelumnya berkomunikasi dengan Caldwell tidak sadar dia mendekat, hanya kebingungan karena sasaran tembaknya tiba-tiba hilang dari pandangan. Sesaat kemudian dia menemukan dirinya terlempar tinggi ke udara. Di antara langit dan bumi yang terbalik, dia menyaksikan dengan putus asa figur itu menghancurkan posisi di depannya.)

column1: (A large number of drones were shot down just as they took off, and chariots were swung and swept over by Ateraxis like toys. Her movements were as coherent as dancing a dance rehearsed thousands of times, and precisely because it was all so simple, she kept slipping in little bits of improvisation.)
column2: (Sejumlah besar drone ditembak jatuh tepat saat lepas landas, dan kereta perang diayun serta disapu Ateraxis seperti mainan. Gerakannya mengalir seperti tarian yang sudah dilatih ribuan kali, dan justru karena semuanya begitu mudah, dia terus menyelipkan improvisasi kecil-kecil.)

column1: (This wasn't the kind of reflexes any living creature should possess, nor was it something a doll, a combat mech, or any radar system could react to—the Niter tried, with the full extent of her computing power, to comprehend her movements—yet she couldn't predict them at all.)
column2: (Ini bukan refleks yang seharusnya dimiliki makhluk hidup mana pun, bukan pula sesuatu yang bisa direspons Doll, mech tempur, atau sistem radar apa pun—Niter itu berusaha, dengan seluruh daya komputasinya, memahami gerakannya—tapi sama sekali tidak bisa memprediksinya.)

column1: (The Niter only knew—Ateraxis could go even faster than this, just occasionally her speed would slow down, even maintaining a distance outside of attacking that allowed the garrison to fire. A few times heat rays and bullets seemed to accidentally catch her, but they were all leisurely blocked by her force field.)
column2: (Niter itu hanya tahu—Ateraxis bisa bergerak lebih cepat lagi dari ini, hanya sesekali kecepatannya melambat, bahkan menjaga jarak di luar jangkauan serang agar garnisun bisa menembak. Beberapa kali sinar panas dan proyektil seolah tak sengaja mengenainya, tapi semuanya diblokir santai oleh force field-nya.)

column1: (At first the Niter thought this was her limit—then she despairingly realized another fact.)
column2: (Awalnya Niter itu mengira itu batas kemampuannya—lalu dengan putus asa dia menyadari fakta lain.)

column1: (She is learning—or rather, this is more like a rehearsal.)
column2: (Dia sedang belajar—atau lebih tepatnya, ini lebih mirip gladi resik.)

column1: (In preparation for her next 'official' performance, she was manufacturing some 'accidents' to test things out.)
column2: (Sebagai persiapan pertunjukan 'resmi' berikutnya, dia sengaja memproduksi beberapa 'kecelakaan' untuk uji coba.)

column1: (Niter crashed heavily to the ground, only to see Ateraxis's fair ankles touch down, lift up, and step right over her.)
column2: (Niter itu terhempas keras ke tanah, hanya untuk melihat pergelangan kaki putih Ateraxis mendarat, terangkat, lalu melangkah tepat di atasnya.)

column1: Stop, you... traitor...
column2: Berhenti, kau... pembelot...

column1: (The absolute directive issued in her neural cloud made her reach out and raise her weapon once again, but before the gathered energy could erupt, it was crushed by Ateraxis in one grasp.)
column2: (Direktif absolut yang dikeluarkan di neural cloud-nya membuatnya kembali mengulurkan tangan dan mengangkat senjata, tapi sebelum energi yang terkumpul meledak, semuanya dihancurkan Ateraxis dalam satu cengkeraman.)

column1: (Those beautiful eyes turned toward Niter, completely devoid of emotion, yet making her too stiff to move. Ateraxis didn't make a move; she merely maximized the stimulation of a certain instinct within her. Just like that, Niter automatically lost consciousness.)
column2: (Mata indah itu menoleh ke arah Niter, sepenuhnya tanpa emosi, tapi membuatnya terlalu kaku untuk bergerak. Ateraxis tidak melakukan apa pun; dia hanya memaksimalkan rangsangan satu insting di dalam diri Niter. Begitu saja, Niter itu otomatis kehilangan kesadaran.)

column1: Morn came and went—and came, and brought no day,
column2: Pagi datang dan pergi—dan datang, tanpa membawa siang,

column1: And men forgot their passions in the dread of this their desolation,
column2: Dan manusia melupakan gairahnya dalam gigil takut atas kehancuran mereka,

column1: And all hearts were chill'd into a selfish prayer for light,
column2: Dan semua hati membeku menjadi doa yang egois demi cahaya,

column1: Every frozen, fractured heart, remembering the light.
column2: Setiap hati yang membeku dan retak, mengingat cahaya itu.

column1: (When she finished reciting this stanza of the poem, there were only ruins and scorched earth around, and no more units capable of resisting.)
column2: (Saat dia selesai melantunkan bait puisi itu, di sekelilingnya tinggal puing dan tanah hangus, tanpa satu pun unit yang masih mampu melawan.)

column1: (Ateraxis, however, slightly furrowed her beautiful thin eyebrows in dissatisfaction, seemingly feeling bored, but ultimately she still took out a small communication device and called up the only projection she cared about.)
column2: (Namun Ateraxis sedikit mengerutkan sepasang alisnya yang tipis dan indah karena tidak puas, seolah merasa bosan, tapi akhirnya dia tetap mengeluarkan perangkat komunikasi kecil dan memanggil satu-satunya proyeksi yang dia pedulikan.)

column1: Hmm, is it over?
column2: Hmm, sudah selesai?

column1: ...Yes, they cannot provide a challenge like the Commander and The Elmo.
column2: ...Ya, mereka tidak bisa memberi tantangan seperti Commander dan The Elmo.

column1: Theoretically speaking, the defensive strength of this place far exceeds the upper limit that Commander could possibly mobilize, especially in terms of firepower.
column2: Secara teori, kekuatan pertahanan tempat ini jauh melampaui batas yang mungkin dikerahkan Commander, terutama dalam hal daya tembak.

column1: It's not the same, they are too easy to predict.
column2: Tidak sama, mereka terlalu mudah diprediksi.

column1: Since you thought of this long ago, maybe you could try sneaking to bypass the obstacles. After all, the current Paradeus is not as efficient at mass-producing high-level Nytos and mechs as in the past.
column2: Kalau kau sudah lama memikirkannya, mungkin kau bisa mencoba menyusup untuk melewati penghalangnya. Lagi pula Paradeus sekarang tidak seefisien dulu dalam memproduksi massal Nyto dan mech tingkat tinggi.

column1: I didn't kill any Niters or Nytos, including any drivers of tanks and mechs, Mother.
column2: Aku tidak membunuh satu pun Niter atau Nyto, termasuk pengemudi tank dan mech, Mother.

column1: The loss of mechs is unavoidable, because I haven't fully learned their structure yet—maybe next time I'll find a way.
column2: Hilangnya mech tidak bisa dihindari, karena aku belum sepenuhnya mempelajari strukturnya—mungkin lain kali aku akan menemukan caranya.

column1: Although I have no intention of increasing your killing impulse, and I truly don't remember setting a moral red line for you...
column2: Meski aku tidak berniat menambah dorongan membunuh dalam dirimu, dan aku sungguh tidak ingat pernah memasang garis merah moral untukmu...

column1: Do you loathe taking lives, Ateraxis?
column2: Apa kau membenci tindakan mengambil nyawa, Ateraxis?

column1: That's not it, Mother.
column2: Bukan begitu, Mother.

column1: The difference between the strong and the weak lies in "who decides whose fate", doesn't it?
column2: Perbedaan antara yang kuat dan yang lemah terletak pada "siapa yang menentukan takdir siapa", bukan?

column1: I choose to let them live, to show that I'm capable of doing so—and if they were ever a threat to me, I'd take their lives with everything I have.
column2: Aku memilih membiarkan mereka hidup, untuk menunjukkan bahwa aku mampu melakukannya—dan kalau mereka sampai menjadi ancaman bagiku, aku akan mengambil nyawa mereka dengan segala yang kupunya.

column1: That's a fine excuse—but that's not "strength", that's "arrogance".
column2: Itu alasan yang bagus—tapi itu bukan "kekuatan", itu "kesombongan".

column1: What you're doing right now is exactly the proof that you're still not perfect.
column2: Apa yang kau lakukan sekarang justru bukti bahwa kau masih belum sempurna.

column1: (Caldwell was still carrying on with the work at hand, her expression as calm as ever, as if she were simply going over her daughter's schoolwork.)
column2: (Caldwell masih melanjutkan pekerjaan di tangannya, ekspresinya tenang seperti biasa, seolah dia sedang sekadar memeriksa PR anaknya.)

column1: (However, Ateraxis's expression wavered for the first time, but she then shook her head slightly, driving the unease away from her expression.)
column2: (Namun ekspresi Ateraxis goyah untuk pertama kalinya, sebelum akhirnya dia menggeleng kecil, mengusir kegelisahan dari wajahnya.)

column1: I'm sorry... Mother.
column2: Maafkan aku... Mother.

column1: But, no matter what, I want to... go see her by myself.
column2: Tapi, apa pun yang terjadi, aku ingin... menemuinya sendiri.

column1: I don't want anyone's will to distort my true heart, nor do I wish to share my soul with anyone.
column2: Aku tidak ingin kehendak siapa pun menyimpangkan isi hatiku yang sejati, dan aku juga tidak ingin membagi jiwaku dengan siapa pun.

column1: I believe that only in this way... can the authority known as 'God' be correctly exercised.
column2: Aku yakin hanya dengan cara ini... otoritas yang disebut 'God' bisa dijalankan dengan benar.

column1: Mother's wish, I have not forgotten in the slightest, and I will definitely fulfill it for you with the highest priority.
column2: Keinginan Mother sedikit pun tidak kulupakan, dan aku pasti akan mewujudkannya untukmu dengan prioritas tertinggi.

column1: I don't need your comfort, especially after knowing you will fail.
column2: Aku tidak butuh hiburanmu, terutama setelah tahu kau akan gagal.

column1: A single Neural cloud cannot withstand the power of the Relics. If you refuse to devour the Neural cloud in the Boojum pronucleus, then you need to fuse more thoroughly with the Child of the Relics, adjusting your own genetic structure to be closer to the wavelength allowed by the Nirvana space.
column2: Satu Neural cloud saja tidak akan mampu menahan kekuatan Relics. Kalau kau menolak menelan Neural cloud di pronukleus Boojum, maka kau harus menyatu lebih menyeluruh dengan Child of the Relics, menyesuaikan struktur genetikmu sendiri agar lebih dekat dengan panjang gelombang yang diizinkan ruang Nirvana.

column1: I am already able to completely control the energy and Boojum cells in my body. Mother, Relic Technology is by no means a secret to me...
column2: Aku sudah mampu mengendalikan sepenuhnya energi dan sel Boojum di tubuhku. Mother, Relic Technology sama sekali bukan rahasia bagiku...

column1: Perhaps you are at your peak state at this moment, and there is no opponent in this world, but Nirvana is not a place where dominance is determined by the level of energy or destructive power.
column2: Mungkin saat ini kau berada di kondisi puncakmu, dan tidak ada lawan di dunia ini, tapi Nirvana bukan tempat di mana dominasi ditentukan oleh besarnya energi atau daya rusak.

column1: The talents you can display are not that crucial in that world.
column2: Bakat yang bisa kau tunjukkan tidak begitu berarti di dunia itu.

column1: On this point alone... I cannot agree with Mother. I am already in my most perfect state. If I cannot succeed now, I won't be able to in the future either.
column2: Hanya soal ini... aku tidak bisa setuju dengan Mother. Aku sudah berada dalam kondisi tersempurnaku. Kalau sekarang aku tidak bisa berhasil, di masa depan pun tidak akan bisa.

column1: Moreover, I read in Mother's research records that, in your hands, an individual indeed once entered Nirvana's space.
column2: Selain itu, aku membaca di catatan riset Mother bahwa di tanganmu, satu individu memang pernah masuk ke ruang Nirvana.

column1: You mean, Elif Nemesis?
column2: Maksudmu, Elif Nemesis?

column1: ...Alright.
column2: ...Baiklah.

column1: Even if there was a chance, her overly stubborn will to resist made her miss it... What's more, she only merely 'touched' that place and received a few special blessings.
column2: Sekalipun ada peluang, kehendaknya yang terlalu keras untuk menolak membuatnya melewatkan itu... Lebih dari itu, dia hanya sekadar 'menyentuh' tempat itu dan menerima beberapa berkah khusus.

column1: This is a completely different situation from what you need to do and what you need to become—the resistance you face is also definitely not something she can compare to.
column2: Ini situasi yang sepenuhnya berbeda dari apa yang harus kau lakukan dan apa yang harus kau jadi—resistensi yang kau hadapi juga jelas bukan sesuatu yang bisa dibandingkan dengannya.

column1: Helena, the Child of the Relic—is the only medium we currently possess that can reach 'her'. You must devour these children to have any chance of success.
column2: Helena, Child of the Relic—adalah satu-satunya medium yang kita miliki sekarang untuk mencapai 'dia'. Kau harus menelan anak-anak itu supaya punya peluang berhasil.

column1: (Caldwell casually explained to Ateraxis—)
column2: (Caldwell menjelaskan dengan santai kepada Ateraxis—)

column1: (Ateraxis responded with a moment of deep thought.)
column2: (Ateraxis menanggapinya dengan hening sejenak dalam pikirannya.)

column1: (Then, she still just shook her head, seemingly facing her creator with immense guilt.)
column2: (Lalu, dia tetap hanya menggeleng, seolah menghadapi penciptanya dengan rasa bersalah yang besar.)

column1: Even those Children of the Relics, I don't want their thoughts to change my mind.
column2: Bahkan Children of the Relics itu, aku tidak ingin pikiran mereka mengubah pendirianku.

column1: Created by Mother, encountering the Commander, learning so much knowledge, achieved upon countless sacrifices... I can only live as 'me', and can only die as 'me'.
column2: Diciptakan oleh Mother, bertemu Commander, mempelajari begitu banyak pengetahuan, semuanya dicapai di atas pengorbanan yang tak terhitung... aku hanya bisa hidup sebagai 'aku', dan hanya bisa mati sebagai 'aku'.

column1: A strong 'self-awareness' is indeed a necessary factor to survive in Nirvana, I won't condemn you for this... But, unfortunately, even the 'prokaryotic' cells of Boojum cannot be fully accepted.
column2: 'Kesadaran diri' yang kuat memang faktor yang diperlukan untuk bertahan di Nirvana, aku tidak akan mencelamu soal ini... Tapi sayangnya, sel 'prokariot' Boojum pun tidak bisa diterima sepenuhnya.

column1: If it's just contact and observation, with your self-control, it might be fine. But if you get involved too deeply, the situation becomes unpredictable.
column2: Kalau hanya kontak dan observasi, dengan kontrol dirimu, mungkin tidak masalah. Tapi kalau kau terlibat terlalu dalam, situasinya jadi tak bisa diprediksi.

column1: If Mother is right, then my failure... is it of any use to you?
column2: Kalau Mother benar, maka kegagalanku... apakah ada gunanya untukmu?

column1: (Caldwell's busy movements finally paused. She still didn't look toward Ateraxis, but there was no doubt this question had begun to occupy her mind.)
column2: (Gerakan sibuk Caldwell akhirnya terhenti. Dia tetap tidak menoleh ke arah Ateraxis, tapi tidak diragukan pertanyaan itu mulai memenuhi pikirannya.)

column1: (Ateraxis gazed at the holographic projection before her, letting out a soft sigh.)
column2: (Ateraxis menatap proyeksi holografis di depannya, melepas embusan napas lirih.)

column1: I know Mother has already started her next plan.
column2: Aku tahu Mother sudah mulai menjalankan rencana berikutnya.

column1: So even if I fail, there will be children who can replace me.
column2: Jadi meski aku gagal, akan ada anak-anak yang bisa menggantikanku.
...Tidak.

column1: The cost of creating you is too high. If you fail... this plan can only be carried out one more time.
column2: Biaya menciptakanmu terlalu tinggi. Kalau kau gagal... rencana ini hanya bisa dijalankan satu kali lagi.

column1: At least based on the resources currently available, that's the case. Even if a subsequent complete Boojum is successfully created, it might not be more obedient than you.
column2: Setidaknya berdasarkan sumber daya yang tersedia sekarang, begitulah. Bahkan kalau Boojum utuh berikutnya berhasil dibuat, belum tentu dia lebih patuh darimu.

column1: Then, will Mother choose to do it herself...
column2: Kalau begitu, apakah Mother akan memilih melakukannya sendiri...

column1: It's possible. After all, you have proven that a completely native Neural cloud cannot completely unify its views on things with its creator.
column2: Mungkin saja. Lagi pula kau sudah membuktikan bahwa Neural cloud yang sepenuhnya asli tidak bisa menyatukan pandangannya sepenuhnya dengan penciptanya.

column1: Or perhaps, I will simply turn to the next research direction and temporarily seal this path.
column2: Atau mungkin, aku akan beralih ke arah riset berikutnya dan menyegel jalan ini untuk sementara.

column1: Relatively speaking, your previous question is more interesting. My answer is—
column2: Sejujurnya, pertanyaanmu sebelumnya lebih menarik. Jawabanku adalah—

column1: Your failure will indeed have value, but that must be on the premise that I can get all the data and information.
column2: Kegagalanmu memang akan bernilai, tapi dengan syarat aku bisa mendapatkan seluruh data dan informasinya.

column1: For this, I need one thing, and that is—
column2: Untuk itu, aku butuh satu hal, yaitu—

column1: (Ateraxis listened silently as she said that thing.)
column2: (Ateraxis mendengarkan dalam diam saat Mother menyebutkan benda itu.)

column1: (Without any hesitation, she brought two fingers together and pierced her own left eye.)
column2: (Tanpa keraguan sedikit pun, dia merapatkan dua jarinya dan menusuk mata kirinya sendiri.)

column1: (For the first time since her birth, a scream of agony escaped her throat. But she didn't stop her movements; she simply endured the pain and gripped the organ her fingertips had plucked out.)
column2: (Untuk pertama kali sejak dia lahir, teriakan kesakitan lolos dari tenggorokannya. Tapi dia tidak menghentikan gerakannya; dia hanya menahan sakit dan menggenggam organ yang baru dicabut ujung jarinya.)

column1: (Vermilion liquid overflowed from her eye sockets. She opened her palm, revealing a condensed star-blue crystal.)
column2: (Cairan merah menyala meluber dari rongga matanya. Dia membuka telapak tangannya, memperlihatkan kristal biru-bintang yang memadat.)

column1: (A long dragon's roar sounded from high above, a giant shadow landed, and the giant dragon let out a low roar, seemingly conveying some kind of concerned emotion.)
column2: (Raungan panjang seekor naga terdengar dari langit tinggi, siluet raksasa mendarat, dan naga besar itu melepas geraman rendah, seolah menyampaikan semacam rasa khawatir.)

column1: I'm fine... Jojo, take this... and give it to Mother.
column2: Aku tidak apa-apa... Jojo, bawa ini... berikan pada Mother.

column1: The excision of important conceptual components will require more time to recover... However, having your eye will indeed be of huge help in observing the results.
column2: Pengangkatan komponen konseptual penting akan butuh waktu lebih lama untuk pulih... Tapi memang, memiliki matamu akan sangat membantu dalam mengamati hasilnya.

column1: Since your resolve is firm, I will not stop you anymore.
column2: Karena tekadmu sudah bulat, aku tidak akan menghalangimu lagi.

column1: At least for everything invested in nurturing you so far, you have paid an equivalent 'price'.
column2: Setidaknya untuk semua yang sudah ditanamkan dalam membesarkanmu sejauh ini, kau sudah membayar 'harga' yang setara.

column1: It seems you've grown quite sensibly in terms of 'character'.
column2: Sepertinya kau tumbuh cukup matang dalam hal 'karakter'.

column1: You have always praised me, acknowledged me.
column2: Kau selalu memujiku, mengakuiku.

column1: Then, for this last time, could you... reprimand me?
column2: Maka, untuk terakhir kali ini, bisakah kau... memarahiku?

column1: (Sigh)
column2: (Menghela napas)

column1: My naive, self-righteous, and childish daughter, the biggest mistake humans can make is thinking they already know too much.
column2: Putriku yang naif, merasa paling benar, dan kekanakan, kesalahan terbesar manusia adalah menganggap dirinya sudah tahu terlalu banyak.

column1: I must congratulate you, for at this moment, you have been reduced to a human.
column2: Aku harus memberi selamat, karena saat ini kau sudah merosot menjadi manusia.

column1: (Caldwell left a soft sigh and cut off the communication.)
column2: (Caldwell meninggalkan satu embusan napas lirih dan memutus komunikasi.)

column1: (Ateraxis raised her head. In the eye sockets she had hollowed out herself, new pupils had already formed, but their functions had not yet fully recovered—the figure of the flying dragon seen through the curtain of blood appeared somewhat blurry.)
column2: (Ateraxis mengangkat kepalanya. Di rongga mata yang dia korek sendiri, pupil baru sudah terbentuk, tapi fungsinya belum sepenuhnya pulih—siluet naga terbang yang terlihat lewat tirai darah tampak agak buram.)

column1: (She gently pressed her hand to the position of a human heart, feeling the unfamiliar yet familiar stinging pain transmitted from there.)
column2: (Dia menekan lembut tangannya ke posisi jantung manusia, merasakan nyeri asing sekaligus akrab yang mengalir dari sana.)

column1: I see... I can indeed feel the pain originating from emotions.
column2: Begitu ya... aku memang bisa merasakan sakit yang berasal dari emosi.

column1: Is this what it feels like to be reduced to a human? Mother...
column2: Jadi begini rasanya merosot menjadi manusia? Mother...

column1: (She closed her eyes, letting the last drop of vermilion liquid slide from the corner of her eye to the ground. And after raising her head again from the shadows, not a trace of emotion or wavering remained.)
column2: (Dia menutup matanya, membiarkan tetes terakhir cairan merah menyala meluncur dari sudut matanya ke tanah. Dan setelah kembali mengangkat kepala dari kegelapan, tidak ada satu jejak emosi atau kebimbangan pun yang tersisa.)

column1: (Ateraxis continued walking forward, destroying the doors, walls, and automated weapons blocking her path, and finally arrived at her destination—)
column2: (Ateraxis terus melangkah maju, menghancurkan pintu, dinding, dan senjata otomatis yang menghalangi jalannya, dan akhirnya sampai di tujuannya—)

column1: (Without a doubt, this is a cage, imprisoning something that even Niters and Nytos consider dangerous.)
column2: (Tidak diragukan, ini adalah kurungan, mengekang sesuatu yang bahkan Niter dan Nyto anggap berbahaya.)

column1: (Behind the concrete door several meters thick, it was dead silent, but Ateraxis could feel the aura emitted by some existence that was no longer life—yet not a dead thing either. It was a crazy, chaotic smell that made living creatures nauseous, but also mixed with a trace of a signal she would never misjudge—)
column2: (Di balik pintu beton setebal beberapa meter, sunyi seperti mati, tapi Ateraxis bisa merasakan aura yang dipancarkan suatu eksistensi yang bukan lagi kehidupan—tapi juga bukan benda mati. Baunya gila dan kacau, membuat makhluk hidup mual, tapi juga bercampur sedikit sinyal yang tidak mungkin dia salah kenali—)

column1: This is the place?
column2: Ini tempatnya?

column1: (As she pressed her hand on the door, waves of energy vibration gushed out like a tide, gradually cutting and eroding the sturdy structure.)
column2: (Saat dia menempelkan tangan ke pintu, gelombang getaran energi menyembur seperti pasang, perlahan mengiris dan mengikis struktur yang kokoh itu.)

column1: (In a few breaths, the heavy door had already cracked, and collapsed in all directions under Ateraxis's light push. She strolled into the pure darkness ahead, welcoming the malicious madness and hostility—her regenerated eyes reflected a scene beyond human sight, clearly looking at someone curled up in the corner, bound by chains.)
column2: (Dalam beberapa tarikan napas, pintu berat itu sudah retak, dan runtuh ke segala arah hanya dengan satu dorongan ringan Ateraxis. Dia melangkah santai ke dalam kegelapan murni di depannya, menyambut kegilaan dan permusuhan yang penuh niat jahat—mata regenerasinya memantulkan pemandangan di luar penglihatan manusia, dengan jelas melihat seseorang meringkuk di sudut, terbelenggu rantai.)

column1: Is it you?
column2: Kau, ya?

column1: Mother's so-called most failed student... was it you who stole Mother's results and opened Nirvana in Lviv?
column2: Murid paling gagal menurut Mother... jadi kau yang mencuri hasil riset Mother dan membuka Nirvana di Lviv?

column1: Alright, alright... who is this?
column2: Wah, wah... siapa ini?

column1: (Wrapped in fireproof fabric whose original color was covered by bloodstains, the crawling figure raised its head. The voice carried the hiss of a viper, and also contained teasing malice.)
column2: (Terbungkus kain tahan api yang warna aslinya tertutup bercak darah, figur yang merangkak itu mengangkat kepalanya. Suaranya membawa desis ular berbisa, sekaligus mengandung niat jahat yang meledek.)

column1: Come on, come closer, let big sister take a look. Whose doll has such a lovely voice—ow ow ow—!
column2: Ayo, mendekatlah, biar Big Sis lihat. Doll siapa yang punya suara semanis ini—aduh aduh aduh—!

column1: I am not a Doll.
column2: Aku bukan Doll.

column1: (Approaching the other party without hesitation, Ateraxis almost immediately suffered some kind of attack. A sharp sound of piercing the air rose from behind her in the darkness, but she grabbed it backhandedly without turning her head, and immediately crushed the other party's shoulder with a stomp.)
column2: (Mendekat tanpa ragu, Ateraxis nyaris langsung menerima semacam serangan. Suara tajam yang membelah udara muncul dari belakangnya dalam kegelapan, tapi dia menangkapnya dengan tangan terbalik tanpa menoleh, lalu langsung menghancurkan bahu pihak itu dengan satu hentakan kaki.)

column1: (A miserable groan came from under Ateraxis's foot. She didn't step back, just ensuring that the damage she caused was clear enough.)
column2: (Erangan menyayat datang dari bawah kaki Ateraxis. Dia tidak menarik kakinya, hanya memastikan kerusakan yang dia timbulkan cukup terasa.)

column1: Just that one little move alone is proof enough that Mother was right... how foolish.
column2: Satu gerakan kecil itu saja sudah cukup membuktikan Mother benar... betapa bodohnya.

column1: You are... that 'beloved daughter', right?
column2: Kau... 'putri kesayangan' itu, kan?

column1: I remember, I remember you... Little Ateraxis, it's Little Ateraxis, right! When you were still in the culture tank, Big Sis was lying there watching you...
column2: Aku ingat, aku ingat kau... Ateraxis Kecil, Ateraxis Kecil, kan! Waktu kau masih di tangki kultur, Big Sis berbaring di sana memperhatikanmu...

column1: Even in that form, I had my own consciousness, and I don't remember you.
column2: Bahkan dalam bentuk itu, aku punya kesadaranku sendiri, dan aku tidak ingat kau.

column1: To actually tell such a lie, it's really unpleasant.
column2: Berani-beraninya berbohong seperti itu, benar-benar tidak menyenangkan.

column1: (A second sound of hard matter shattering and collapsing came from beneath Ateraxis's feet, as if some massive object was being crushed.)
column2: (Suara kedua materi keras yang pecah dan runtuh datang dari bawah kaki Ateraxis, seolah ada benda masif yang sedang dihancurkan.)

column1: (That vague sound turned into a miserable wail, and the countless chains binding her all made a noisy sound together.)
column2: (Suara samar itu berubah menjadi ratapan menyayat, dan rantai tak terhitung yang membelenggunya berbunyi berisik serentak.)

column1: Be quiet.
column2: Diam.

column1: I will get you out.
column2: Aku akan mengeluarkanmu.

column1: Did... did Professor Caldwell send you? As expected, she still wants it, right? The knowledge regarding 'that side'...
column2: Apa... apa Professor Caldwell yang mengirimmu? Sudah kuduga, dia masih menginginkannya, kan? Pengetahuan tentang 'sisi itu'...

column1: Even though I was tricked into getting it out, I did it... Now even she should admit how amazing I am, right!?
column2: Meski aku ditipu supaya mengeluarkannya, aku berhasil... Sekarang bahkan dia harus mengakui betapa hebatnya aku, kan!?

column1: Mother has no need for your power to open the Relics.
column2: Mother tidak butuh kekuatanmu untuk membuka Relics.

column1: The one who needs it, is me.
column2: Yang membutuhkannya, adalah aku.

column1: What did you... say... Could it be...
column2: Apa yang kau... katakan... Jangan-jangan...

column1: Chiloveig, because you're very annoying, I will only say this name once—
column2: Chiloveig, karena kau sangat menjengkelkan, aku hanya akan menyebut nama ini sekali—

column1: I want you to assist me in opening the door to Nirvana. Freedom and your life will be the reward. You have 3 seconds to consider.
column2: Aku ingin kau membantuku membuka pintu ke Nirvana. Kebebasan dan nyawamu jadi imbalannya. Kau punya 3 detik untuk berpikir.

column1: Eh, eh?!? Don't tell me you've—you've betrayed them? Now I really want to see the teacher's exp—"
column2: Eh, eh?!? Jangan bilang kau—kau membelot dari mereka? Sekarang aku benar-benar ingin lihat ekspresi guru—"

column1: <size=28>No problem!</size>
column2: <size=28>Tidak masalah!</size>

column1: I promise! I promise! Don't leave me here as a lab animal anymore! That man is a total pervert! Although I think I can be a bit hardcore sometimes, that's really too much!
column2: Aku janji! Aku janji! Jangan tinggalkan aku di sini jadi hewan lab lagi! Pria itu benar-benar cabul! Meski aku sendiri kadang bisa agak hardcore, yang itu sudah kelewatan!

column1: Just get me out of here! I'll work my heart out for you!
column2: Pokoknya keluarkan aku dari sini! Aku akan kerja mati-matian untukmu!

column1: (The sticky cries for help and begging for mercy in the air lasted for a while, until a flash of red light swept past. Immediately, all the chains made a crisp breaking sound almost simultaneously, and Chiloveig's heavy body fell to the ground.)
column2: (Jeritan minta tolong dan permohonan ampun yang lengket itu bergaung sesaat di udara, sampai kilatan cahaya merah melintas. Seketika, semua rantai berbunyi patah nyaring nyaris serentak, dan tubuh berat Chiloveig jatuh ke tanah.)

column1: Phew, is this the taste of freedom... Little Ateraxis, thanks! But how did you get in? Did you really take out all the guards?
column2: Fyuh, jadi ini rasanya kebebasan... Ateraxis Kecil, makasih! Tapi bagaimana kau bisa masuk? Kau benar-benar menghabisi semua penjaganya?

column1: Ahaha, that feels great!
column2: Ahaha, rasanya luar biasa!

column1: Lead the way.
column2: Tunjukkan jalannya.

column1: Mhm-hmm, I wonder where little Ateraxis wants to be taken? Big Sis here is very confident in romance-related topics—ah, just kidding, just kidding! I know where you want to go, let's start from over there—
column2: Mmm-hmm, ke mana ya Ateraxis Kecil ingin diantar? Big Sis ini sangat percaya diri soal topik romansa—ah, cuma bercanda, cuma bercanda! Aku tahu ke mana kau ingin pergi, ayo mulai dari sana—

column1: (Ateraxis made no move to restrain her prisoner, because both of them knew perfectly well that in her presence, any attempt to flee, no matter the distance, meant nothing.)
column2: (Ateraxis tidak berusaha mengikat tahanannya, karena keduanya sama-sama paham bahwa di hadapannya, usaha kabur sejauh apa pun tidak berarti apa-apa.)

column1: (Chiloveig chattered on about her hardships, and to Ateraxis, this was another kind of prison built from useless information.)
column2: (Chiloveig terus berceloteh soal penderitaannya, dan bagi Ateraxis, itu adalah jenis penjara lain yang dibangun dari informasi tak berguna.)

column1: (But if this was the price to achieve the sole goal she was created for... she gladly endured it.)
column2: (Tapi kalau ini harga untuk mencapai satu-satunya tujuan dia diciptakan... dia menanggungnya dengan senang hati.)

column1: (Lunasia... I'm coming.)
column2: (Lunasia... aku datang.)

column1: (Please, don't reject me... let's have a good talk... about the most beautiful ending for us, for everyone.)
column2: (Kumohon, jangan tolak aku... mari bicara baik-baik... tentang akhir terindah bagi kita, bagi semua orang.)
